name: Open Storage Cabinet
description: Open-front storage cabinet, 800 x 400 x 720 mm: 18 mm shell, one mid-height shelf, and a 60 mm toe-kick recess at the front.

steps.instruction: Create the cabinet blank: a box 800 mm wide (X), 400 mm deep (Y) and 720 mm tall, centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0. The front face is at Y=-200.

transcript.user_prompt: Start a storage cabinet: a solid box 800 mm wide (X), 400 mm deep (Y) and 720 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on the floor at Z=0. The face at Y=-200 will be the open front.
transcript.assistant_message: I've blocked out the 800 x 400 x 720 mm cabinet blank with its front face at Y=-200.

steps.instruction: Shell the blank with 18 mm walls, leaving the front face (Y=-200) fully open.

transcript.user_prompt: Hollow it into a carcass: shell the box with 18 mm walls on the back, both sides, top and bottom, leaving the whole front face at Y=-200 open.
transcript.assistant_message: The blank is now an open-front shell with 18 mm walls all round - a 764 mm wide, 684 mm tall cavity behind the opening.

steps.instruction: Add a fixed shelf 764 mm wide, 382 mm deep and 18 mm thick inside the cabinet, spanning Z=342 to Z=360, flush with the front opening and reaching the back wall.

transcript.user_prompt: Split the cavity with one fixed shelf at mid height: 764 mm wide and 18 mm thick, spanning the full 382 mm from the front opening back to the inside of the back wall, positioned from Z=342 to Z=360.
transcript.assistant_message: The mid shelf is in at 342-360 mm, dividing the cabinet into two equal open compartments.

steps.instruction: Cut a toe-kick recess across the full width at the front bottom: remove all material within 60 mm of the front face (Y=-200 to Y=-140) below Z=60.

transcript.user_prompt: Give it a plinth: cut a toe-kick recess along the whole front bottom edge, removing everything within 60 mm of the front face (from Y=-200 back to Y=-140) below Z=60.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the 60 x 60 mm toe-kick under the front - the cabinet now sets back at floor level so you can stand close to it.
